Principles of Macroevolution
¨Macroevolution is not goal-oriented
¤The evolution of the horse (Equus)
explanation: This slide emphasizes that macroevolution is not a goal-oriented process, using the evolution of the horse (Equus) as a model of adaptation to changing environments rather than a directed march toward a modern form.

questions.q: Which organism's evolutionary history is used to illustrate that macroevolution is not goal-oriented?
questions.exp: The notes use the evolution of the horse (Equus) to show that macroevolution is not goal-oriented.
